caveats: Stand-in table, not real pricing: every value marked 'assumption' is a placeholder pending real estimating data (CCC / Mitchell / Audatex).

Bounds, not calibrated intervals: low and high are the table's plausible bounds for the visible damage. They are not a statistical confidence interval, and how often real costs fall inside them has not been measured.
Hidden damage: only visible damage is priced. The high end includes an uplift when any item needs replacement, but structural, mechanical and underbody damage are not priced.
Parts type: the low end assumes aftermarket or repaired parts; the high end assumes OEM parts.
Region: labor uses the configured region tier; real body shop rates vary a lot by state.

Missing cost drivers, not included: ADAS sensor recalibration, paint blending into adjacent panels, taxes, rental and towing, storage, sublet work, and EV-specific work (battery inspection, high-voltage safety procedures).
